veliPaneli.notParent: This page is for parent accounts only.

noChildren.title: No student linked yet
noChildren.text: Once you link a student account to your parent account, study statistics will appear here.

sonrakiAdim.title: Next step
sonrakiAdim.desc: A few small steps are left to start using Hupo with your child. You can complete each one whenever you like.
sonrakiAdim.error: We couldn't load your next step right now.
sonrakiAdim.empty: There are no steps to show right now.

cocuk_ekle.aciklama: Create a pairing code. The code is valid for 24 hours.

eslestir.aciklama: Your child enters the code in the Hupolingo app under Settings → Connect to parent.

ilk_ders.aciklama: Progress will appear on this page once your child answers the first question.

deneme_veya_plan.aciklama: Look at the plans and pick the one that suits your child.

cocukEkle.title: Add your child
cocukEkle.desc: Create a code and have your child enter it in the Hupolingo app under Settings → Connect to parent. The code is valid for 24 hours and can be used once.
cocukEkle.replaceNote: Creating a new code cancels the previous one.
cocukEkle.copyError: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it manually.
cocukEkle.error: Could not create the code. Please try again shortly.
cocukEkle.webText: Your child can also use it on a computer:
cocukEkle.webLink: Open the student app on the web

cocuklarim.title: My children
cocuklarim.desc: Students linked to your account. You see study information only after you give consent to share it.

empty.title: No child linked yet
empty.text: Create the code below. Your child enters it in the Hupolingo app under Settings → Connect to parent.

rizaYardim.verildi: You can see study information on the dashboard.
rizaYardim.bekliyor: To see study information, give consent from the card on the home page.
rizaYardim.geri_cekildi: To see study information again, you need to give consent again.

kaldirOnay.metin: After this, you will not be able to see this student's study information. The student and you will be notified. Linking again requires a new code.

cocuklarim.hata: The action could not be completed. Please try again shortly.

genelDurum.title: Overall status
genelDurum.kaynak: Last 7 days. This section does not measure learning level on its own; it summarises study records.
genelDurum.durumBos: No study activity this week yet. This summary fills in once your child starts solving questions. When you are ready, you can start together with a short session.
genelDurum.durumGun: This week your child studied on {gun, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and solved {soru, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}.
genelDurum.durumTekrar: {tekrar, plural, one {# topic is} other {# topics are}} due for review.
genelDurum.durumTekrarYok: No topics are due for review.

ogrenme.oranNot: Based on questions solved in the last 7 days.
ogrenme.yetersizNot: A rate needs at least {min} questions.
ogrenme.uyari: XP and time are not measures of learning and are not included in this card.

duzen.uyari: Routine shows study rhythm; it is not a measure of learning level.

destek.oneri: A short review of “{konu}” could help this week.
destek.yokOneri: No topics are due for review right now. This is a good time to start a new topic.
destek.sure: You can review together for {dk} minutes: ask about the topic first, then solve one or two questions together.
destek.uyari: Suggestions are based only on study records; they are not a diagnosis.

dikkat.pasif: No study records in the last 3 days. Even a short session makes it easier to start again.
dikkat.tekrar: {sayi, plural, one {# topic is} other {# topics are}} due for review. Starting with one topic is enough.
dikkat.not: This is not an evaluation; it only reflects what the study records show.

buHafta.title: This week
buHafta.kaynak: Last 7 days. Time and question count show study rhythm; they do not measure learning level on their own.
buHafta.azVeriNot: A rate needs at least {min} questions.
buHafta.tekrarNot: Topics answered incorrectly or due for review.
buHafta.bos: No study activity recorded this week yet.
buHafta.bosNot: This summary fills in once your child starts solving questions.

weekly.title: Weekly Study
weekly.desc: Time spent and questions solved over the last 7 days
weekly.kaynak: Source: daily study records for the last 7 days (time and question count).
weekly.empty: No study activity recorded this week yet.
weekly.emptyNot: Daily study time will appear here once your child solves questions.
weekly.ozet: In the last 7 days: {dk} min of study and {soru} questions in total.

subjects.title: Success by Subject
subjects.desc: Distribution of solved questions by correct-answer rate
subjects.kaynak: Source: questions your child solved. The rate is correct answers divided by total questions.
subjects.insufficient: Not enough data yet (at least 6 questions needed)
subjects.ozet: {sayi} subjects have enough data. Lowest success: {ders} ({oran}%).

review.title: Review Suggestions
review.kaynak: Source: topics answered incorrectly or due for review. The rate is the share of correct answers for that topic.
review.subject: Subject
review.empty: No topics need review. Great job!

achievements.title: Badges
achievements.desc: Badges the student has earned and is working towards
achievements.xpNote: XP and level show progress inside the game; they do not measure learning level. For topic-level success, see the Subjects page.

membership.desc: Your subscription, plan, payment history and communication preferences.

plans.title: Paid plan
plans.error: Plan information could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.
plans.preparing: A paid plan is in preparation. It will appear in this card once plans and prices are announced.
plans.checkoutError: The payment page could not be opened. Please try again shortly.
plans.paymentNote: You complete the payment with your card on the iyzico payment page.
plans.cancelNote: To cancel, contact our support team.
plans.onBilgiKabul: I have read the <link>pre-information form and distance sales agreement</link> and accept them.
plans.onBilgiCayma: I want the service to start before the withdrawal period ends. I acknowledge that my right of withdrawal may not be available to the extent the service has been performed.
plans.onBilgiIpucu: Please tick both checkboxes to continue to payment.

ogrenmeHaritasi.title: Learning Map
ogrenmeHaritasi.desc: Your child's status against school learning outcomes, by week and unit.
ogrenmeHaritasi.empty: No questions solved yet. Once your child starts solving questions, the learning outcome map for each subject will appear here.
ogrenmeHaritasi.sinifYok: The student's grade is missing, so the learning outcome map cannot be shown.
ogrenmeHaritasi.planYok: A learning outcome plan is not yet defined for this subject.
ogrenmeHaritasi.kazanimYok: No learning outcome list was found for this subject and grade.
ogrenmeHaritasi.bugunYok: School calendar information is not available for this week.
ogrenmeHaritasi.bugunSayi: {sayi} learning outcomes are taught in school this week.
ogrenmeHaritasi.sinifNot: For grades 1–4, percentages are not shown; the outcome status is presented qualitatively.
ogrenmeHaritasi.kaynak: The status is based on the correct-answer rate for questions your child solved for each outcome and on how they were repeated over time. If there are not enough answers, no status is shown. This screen is not a diagnosis, score or proficiency assessment.
ogrenmeHaritasi.filtreBos: No outcomes in this subject need support.

durumAciklama.veriYok: At least 6 answers are needed for a status.
durumAciklama.pekisiyor: Practice on this outcome is ongoing.
durumAciklama.guclu: Answered correctly on different days and in spaced repeats.

subjectsPage.empty: No questions solved yet. Subject success will appear here once your child starts solving questions.
subjectsPage.topicsDesc: Topics answered incorrectly or due for review in {ders}
subjectsPage.topicsKaynak: Source: topic records for this subject. A rate is shown for topics with at least 6 solved questions.
subjectsPage.topicsEmpty: No topics in this subject need review.
subjectsPage.topicsNote: This page shows a subject-level summary. A full topic-by-topic progress report will come in a later update.

reviewPage.desc: Questions whose last answer was wrong and topics due for review.
reviewPage.kaynak: Source: questions whose last answer was wrong, and topics due for review.
reviewPage.empty: No topics need review right now. This list updates as your child solves new questions.
reviewPage.limitNote: The 10 topics that most need review are shown.

iletisimIzni.title: My communication preferences
iletisimIzni.text: We send you marketing messages by email only if you have clearly agreed to receive subscription, product and campaign information. You can withdraw your consent at any time; sign-in, password and security emails are not affected.
iletisimIzni.error: Your preference could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
iletisimIzni.loadError: Your preferences could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.

goalsPage.title: Daily Goals
goalsPage.desc: Your child's daily study goal and this week's completion
goalsPage.weeklyEmpty: No study sessions this week yet.

activityPage.title: Last 7 Days Activity
activityPage.kaynak: Source: daily study records for the last 7 days. The daily rate is shown on days with at least 6 solved questions.
activityPage.empty: No study sessions this week yet.
activityPage.emptyNot: The daily summary will appear here as your child solves questions.

consent.title: Use of Children's Data
consent.gate: The student's study data is shown after parental consent is given. You can give consent in the card below.
consent.notice: Parental consent is required before we can collect your child's study data.
consent.desc: The data is processed for educational purposes only, is never shared with third parties, and consent can be withdrawn at any time.
consent.ogretmenNotice: If your child has a teacher, the teacher sees only a class-level summary. The summary does not include names, email addresses or individual answers. Progress values are not shown when fewer than 3 students in the class have answered.
consent.error: The operation could not be completed.
consent.saveError: Consent could not be saved. Please try again.

abonelik.iptalNot: To cancel, contact our support team.

denemeKaydi.katilimLabel: I have read the participation terms of this practice exam for my child and I accept them. The phone number will be used only for reminders about this exam.
denemeKaydi.katilimNot: Required. Needed to register for the exam.
denemeKaydi.pazarlamaLabel: I allow Hupolingo to send product and campaign messages to my phone.
denemeKaydi.pazarlamaNot: Optional. You can still complete the exam registration without ticking this.
